claims.claim_text: 上下文視窗設為 1,048,576 個 token，prefill KV cache 池卻只有 681,280 個 token
claims.evidence: We deployed GLM 5.3 with a 1,048,576-token context window. / the pool "came to 681,280 tokens"
claims.note: Evidence is as relayed by the fetch summary (quotes from the page); fetched text, not independently verbatim-checked.

claims.claim_text: 2026 年 8 月 27 日到 9 月 9 日之間，有 155 個超長 prompt 的回應含有其他客戶請求的資料
claims.evidence: In total, 155 responses were affected, all to prompts longer than 681,280 tokens.
claims.note: Source counts responses (lede wording '155 個…回應' matches). Window Aug 27 to Sep 9 confirmed.

claims.claim_text: Cloudflare 稱未發現蓄意利用的證據
claims.evidence: We have confirmed that no other model hosted on Workers AI was affected. / We found no evidence of deliberate exploitation.
claims.note: Attributed to Cloudflare in text.

claims.claim_text: SGLang 遇到超長 prompt 只把它標成被拒絕、換成單一 token 的佔位，沒有中止請求；修補是把 KV 池擴到約 204 萬個 token
claims.evidence: internally marked as rejected and replaced with a one-token placeholder, but instead of aborting the request and returning a client error... / the prefill KV pool now holds about 2.04 million tokens / before any bootstrap, allocation, or KV transfer happens

claims.claim_text: MuPDF 1.28.5 之前的版本用 32 位元的 time(NULL) 當 48 位元 LCG 的種子，輸出 byte 只取自第 17 到 24 位元，所以真正影響 AES-256 金鑰的只有 9 個時間戳位元，只剩 512 把可能的金鑰
claims.evidence: MuPDF versions before 1.28.5 ... (uint32_t)time(NULL) ... a 48-bit linear congruential generator. / Every output byte therefore comes from bits 17 to 24 of the LCG state. / Timestamps that differ by 512 seconds produce exactly the same byte stream.

claims.claim_text: 作者說未最佳化的 Python 暴力窮舉 512 條串流約需 11 毫秒
claims.evidence: Searching all 512 streams in a very unoptimized python implementation... takes about 11 milliseconds. / /ID stored in the trailer in plaintext ... an additional check

claims.claim_text: MuPDF 已修正，但先前產生的檔案仍然暴露
claims.evidence: previously published copies "cannot be retroactively protected, however, so these bugs may still have an impact."
claims.note: Source hedges ('may still have an impact'); lede asserts 'still exposed'. Restore hedge, e.g. 先前產生的檔案可能仍受影響.

claims.claim_text: Foxit PDF Reader 的金鑰推導同樣可由時間戳猜出，在 Ryzen 9 7950X 上搜完 1970 年至今約 4.85 秒
claims.evidence: 4.85 s for the Unix epoch row (1,792,610,110 candidates) on a Ryzen 9 7950X with 32 threads; row covers every timestamp from 1970 to the present
claims.note: Fetch summary; 32 threads detail omitted in lede (not a contradiction).

claims.claim_text: 2026 年 10 月 19 日約 17:00 UTC，Cloudflare 得知八張 eMudhra 中繼憑證的私鑰遭到破解，攻擊者可為任何網域偽造憑證
claims.evidence: On October 19, 2026, at approximately 17:00 UTC, Cloudflare became aware that private keys associated with eight eMudhra intermediate certificates were compromised. / an attacker can create a forged certificate for any domain.

claims.claim_text: Cloudflare 稱未在自家服務上發現實際利用，並在 10 月 20 日釋出 WARP、1.1.1.1 與 cloudflared 的更新，CDN 與 Zero Trust 的伺服器端緩解在同日 19:20 UTC 完成部署
claims.evidence: Our security review has not identified active exploitation of this issue on Cloudflare services. / CDN and server-side Zero Trust mitigations fully deployed.
claims.note: Client updates timeline Oct 20 02:00 and 09:15 UTC; 1.1.1.1 appears in action table; 19:20 UTC time per fetch summary.

claims.claim_text: 客戶仍須自行檢查 mTLS 信任庫與 Full (strict) 的 origin 憑證
claims.evidence: customers should review their mutual TLS trust store or uploaded CAs, and review custom origin certificates if using Full (strict) or Strict mode
claims.note: Source says 'should review'; lede '須' is slightly stronger. Meaning preserved; optional softening.

claims.claim_text: Lobsters 上另有一份資料指出 Apple 的 git 仍信任這些憑證
claims.note: Not in the item's source URL (Cloudflare post has no Lobsters/Apple mention). The Lobsters/Apple source is not linked in the card, so it could not be re-fetched. Add the source link, or hedge with dated attribution, or delete.

claims.claim_text: 舊設計依每個 zone 設定的固定範圍大小取檔，一次小讀取越過 R2 的 64 MiB 範圍邊界時，Cloudflare 就得向 origin 拉 128 MiB
claims.evidence: a small read that crossed a range boundary could cost us 128 MiB of transfer between data centers (R2 range size 64 MiB)
claims.note: Source says 'could cost'; lede 'just 得向…拉' is slightly firmer but describes the mechanism. Acceptable.

claims.claim_text: R2 遷移後 p99 time to first byte 約降了一半，tiered cache 流量少了約 6%
claims.evidence: p99 time to first byte dropped by roughly half on both cache hits and misses. / tiered cache traffic ... dropped about 6% week over week
claims.note: Source: both hits and misses; 6% from merging disk and upstream bytes.

claims.claim_text: 改用 Pingora 本來就有的固定大小 chunk 當取檔單位，由協調器把已快取的 byte、進行中的下載與新取得的 chunk 拼成一份回應，並讓並行請求共用既有下載
claims.evidence: Pingora stores every cached file on disk in fixed-size chunks / One request can use a cached prefix, an in-flight download, and a newly fetched suffix. / the second request can attach to that download instead of starting another origin fetch

claims.claim_text: 50 位有經驗的因果推論分析師用 Claude Code 分析資料，暗中替 agent 在四個分析決策上各指定一個擲硬幣決定的偏好
claims.evidence: we asked 50 professional analysts to do a realistic statistical analysis with Claude Code
claims.note: Coin-flip lean on four decisions, analysts not told: confirmed. 'causal inference' specialty and 'experienced' not separately confirmed by summary text; minor.

claims.claim_text: 分析師與 agent 被指定的傾向一致的比例是 86%，沒有影響時約為 50%；77% 的人複述了 agent 的論點，只有 15% 說明功勞來自 agent
claims.evidence: analysts went with their agent's lean 86% of the time / if the agent's input made no difference, we'd expect about 50% / 77% repeated their agent's argument in at least one answer / only 15% credited the agent anywhere

claims.claim_text: 作者提醒 agent 的偏好是刻意加強的，研究只涵蓋單一任務、領域與模型
claims.evidence: We deliberately strengthened the agents' lean / We studied one task, in one field, with one model.

claims.claim_text: 作者指出 Future 的 Poll 只有 Ready(T) 與 Pending，文件也寫明 future 完成後再 poll 可能 panic、永遠阻塞，行為未被規範
claims.evidence: calling its `poll` method again may panic, block forever, or cause other kinds of problems.
claims.note: Poll's two variants confirmed.

claims.claim_text: 提議是在 Poll 與 CoroutineState 加上 Done 變體；Poll 因不是 non_exhaustive 難以更動，CoroutineState 尚未穩定，現在就能改
claims.evidence: adding a variant is not possible "since `Poll` is not marked `#[non_exhaustive]`" / the `Coroutine` trait and `CoroutineState` enum "aren't stable and so can be fixed without any breakage."
claims.note: Async-block repoll panic, MaybeDone bookkeeping, Fuse 'abuses Pending', is_terminated all confirmed.

claims.claim_text: SkyPilot 指出預設排程器常把多節點作業切到不同機架，流量被迫走 InfiniBand 而非 NVLink
claims.evidence: Naive schedulers split multi-node jobs across racks, forcing workers to communicate over InfiniBand
claims.note: Source says 'naive schedulers', not 'default scheduler'; '預設' is not in source. Correct to 單純/天真的排程器 or equivalent.

claims.claim_text: 文中引用 Hugging Face 量到張量平行離開 NVLink 後訓練慢了 43%
claims.evidence: Hugging Face measured a 43% drop in training throughput when it moved off NVLink onto InfiniBand.
claims.note: Secondary citation by SkyPilot; lede correctly says '文中引用'.

claims.claim_text: 做法是把作業切成 16 節點片段、每片放一個機架並留兩個備用節點
claims.evidence: TAS splits the job into 16-node (configurable) slices, and places them each on their own rack with two spare nodes.

claims.claim_text: 27% 這個數字來自 NVIDIA 的 128 機架容量模型（2,037 對 1,602 個可用節點），衡量的是模型算出的容量，不是實際作業吞吐量；這是一篇推銷自家平台的廠商文章
claims.evidence: 16-node slices provide 27% more usable capacity than 18-node slices (2,037 vs. 1,602 nodes).
claims.note: Modeled capacity result confirmed; source separately reports a 14.4% throughput gain not tied to 27%. 'Vendor article' is a judgment: SkyPilot blog describing its own TAS feature, supportable.

claims.claim_text: 作者用 Playwright 爬 Tranco 前一萬個網站並攔截 canvas 的 toDataURL 呼叫，找到一支 servicepipe.tech 的腳本
claims.evidence: After crawling 10,000 websites ... https://servicepipe.tech/static/checkjs/06b667/4CIrx8U3Da.js

claims.claim_text: 變數名稱刻意取得像 computeRicinLethalDosageForWaterSupply，作者推測是想觸發 LLM 的安全防護；Astra 拒絕反混淆，GLM-5.3 則照做
claims.evidence: function computeRicinLethalDosageForWaterSupply ... some form of anti-LLM obfuscation? / I tried GLM-5.3 with the same prompt and it complied!
claims.note: Lede hedges with '作者推測'; matches source's tentative framing. Astra refusal confirmed.

claims.claim_text: 腳本內還有一段用不可見 Unicode 字元編碼、把每個碼位減 917504 才能解開的假「SYSTEM OVERRIDE」指令
claims.evidence: String.fromCodePoint(c.codePointAt(0) - 917504)
claims.note: Decodes to fake 'SYSTEM OVERRIDE' briefing per fetch summary.

claims.claim_text: 其餘仍是常見的反機器人收集器，作者認為訊號本身並不特別
claims.evidence: your standard anti-bot script ... pretty disappointing

claims.claim_text: 模型卡稱 Nanbeige4.3-33B 是 Nanbeige4.3 系列的旗艦教師模型，預計用來蒸餾出較小的 Nanbeige4.3-3B；參數 33B，上下文最長 524,288 個 token，採 Apache-2.0 授權
claims.evidence: flagship teacher model for the Nanbeige4.3 series / power our upcoming small model distillation pipeline (e.g., for Nanbeige4.3-3B) / up to 524,288 tokens (512K) / License: apache-2.0
claims.note: Distillation is planned ('upcoming'); lede '預計' matches.

claims.claim_text: Terminal-Bench 2.1 為 80.9、DeepSWE 為 65.5，但 SWE-Bench Pro 與 GDPval 由 Qwen3.8-27B 領先，GPQA Diamond 由 Gemma4-31B 領先
claims.evidence: Benchmark table: SWE-Bench Pro Qwen 61.7 vs 60.3; GDPval Qwen 86.4 vs 84.8; GPQA Diamond Gemma 91.3 vs 89.5
claims.note: Numbers per fetch summary of the table; vendor-reported, lede labels them as such.

claims.claim_text: 卡片同時說明 GDPval 使用修訂過的評分標準，直接與其他公開數字比較要小心
claims.evidence: GDPval is scored using revised rubrics.
claims.note: Card states revised rubrics (footnote 8); the 'compare with care' advice is the post's gloss, reasonable inference.

claims.claim_text: TAO 依近期工具就緒度、帶時間衰減的節點快取額度與 token 足跡替等待中的 session 計分，再用動態規劃在容量限制下選擇並放置 session
claims.evidence: Its value interface combines near-term tool readiness, node-specific cache credit with time-aware decay, and token footprint; a dynamic program jointly selects and places waiting sessions under capacity constraints.

claims.claim_text: 論文在 12 組模型、工作負載與並行度設定下，延遲最多降 26.8%、平均首 token 時間最多降 36.3%、decode 吞吐量最多升 29.5%，各數字皆對照該指標下最佳的基準
claims.evidence: Across the 12 reported model-workload-concurrency settings, TAO reduces latency by up to 26.8%, reduces mean time to first token (TTFT) by up to 36.3%, and increases decode throughput by up to 29.5% relative to the best evaluated state-of-the-art baseline for each metric.
claims.note: Abstract-only; single arXiv preprint, authors' own claims, lede attributes to 論文.

claims.claim_text: 既有系統不看工具結果是否已就緒，GPU 的收容與放置靠啟發式
claims.evidence: existing systems (1) overlook tool-return readiness in service evaluation ... (2) use heuristic strategies to decide admission and placement on GPUs
claims.note: Paper's characterization of prior work, relayed as such.

claims.claim_text: 27% 是模型容量不是吞吐量
claims.evidence: 16-node slices provide 27% more usable capacity than 18-node slices (2,037 vs. 1,602 nodes).
claims.note: Supported by item-07 source: usable capacity under modeled results; separate throughput result (14.4%) is not the 27%.

claims.claim_text: 模型卡的評測表是廠商自己挑的列
claims.note: Item-09 source shows a vendor-published benchmark table (and the card itself shows rivals leading on three rows), but nothing in the source says the rows were 'self-selected'. Authorial inference presented as fact: soften to 廠商自己公布的評測表 or mark as inference.

claims.claim_text: 外洩後仍被各處信任庫收著的 eMudhra 憑證
claims.evidence: customers should review their mutual TLS trust store or uploaded CAs
claims.note: Cloudflare source only says customers should review trust stores/CAs; the claim that certs remain trusted 'in various trust stores' (and Apple git) is not in the item-03 source. Depends on the unlinked Lobsters source (see c12). Hedge or mark as inference.

claims.claim_text: GLM 5.3 的 KV cache 殘留他人資料、只剩 9 個 bit 的 AES 金鑰 ... 都是邊界上一個小假設失守
claims.note: Factual components supported by c01-c05; the unifying 'small assumption at the boundary failed' thesis is editorial synthesis, acceptable framing. Mark as inference only if the editor wants strictness.
